text: huluTable 是面向 DSH Web 的表格工作区插件，会在侧边栏底部添加入口，并在全屏面板中提供表格库和编辑器。用户可以从空白表或模板创建表格，编辑单元格、筛选排序、使用公式和看板等视图，也能导入或导出 Excel 与 CSV。数据由浏览器 IndexedDB 持久化，支持表格管理、撤销和单元格历史，适合在 DSH 中维护轻量业务清单、项目进度或客户数据；需要 DSH Web 客户端，不需要额外账号或 API Key。

huluTable adds a table workspace to the DSH Web sidebar. Create tables from templates, edit cells with formulas, filter and sort records, and switch views. Import or export Excel and CSV; browser IndexedDB stores data. Useful for project and customer lists, without an account or API key.
想在 DSH 里用类似电子表格的界面整理业务数据。
我需要把客户清单按阶段放进可拖动的看板。
能不能在 DSH 中编辑表格并用公式计算单元格？
我想把 Excel 或 CSV 导入 DSH 表格，再导出处理结果。
I want a spreadsheet-style workspace inside the DSH web client.
Can I organize records in a kanban view and move them between stages?
huluTable 的功能「表格库」：在工作区列出并搜索表格，可创建空白表或模板表，也能重命名、复制、收藏和移入回收站。
huluTable 的功能「公式与编辑」：在表格网格中修改单元格，并通过公式栏计算包含单元格引用和范围的表达式；控制器管理撤销状态和公式缓存。
huluTable 的功能「文件导入导出」：从 xlsx 或 CSV 文件读取表格数据并生成列类型建议，也可将整表或指定行导出为 xlsx 或 CSV 文件。
huluTable 的功能「看板视图」：按下拉列的选项把记录分组为泳道，用户可拖动卡片改变记录的分组值。
huluTable 将表格文档和单元格历史保存在浏览器 IndexedDB；若存储不可用，控制器会退化为内存状态，数据不会持久保留。
我想在浏览器里保存并管理多个可搜索的工作表。
I need a lightweight way to import CSV records, edit them, and export a spreadsheet.

dsh-hulutable-plugin README · huluTable：> A DeepSeek Harness Web client plugin: a "Tables" trigger in the sidebar footer plus a full-viewport table workspace — foolproof online-table data management.
> No database, no server: all data lives in the browser's IndexedDB and works out of the box. Current release: **v0.1**.

dsh-hulutable-plugin README · huluTable：huluTable brings an online spreadsheet into DeepSeek Harness: a table library, a virtualized grid editor, 18 column types, formulas, filters and sorts, kanban/calendar/chart views, Excel import/export and more. Double-click a cell to edit, drag the corner to fill series, right-click for row/column menus — every change is undoable.

dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Features：| Area | Capabilities |
|---|---|
| Table library | List/search/tags/stars; create blank or from 6 templates (Customer CRM, Projects, Finance ledger, Attendance, To-dos, Inventory); rename/duplicate/delete; recycle bin (30-day TTL); **one-click JSON backup/restore** |
| Grid editor | Virtual scrolling (10k+ rows); double-click editing; drag-select / Shift-extend; copy-paste (Excel TSV included); fill drag (increment/decrement/series/copy); delta-level undo/redo; **long-press drag to reorder rows/columns**; **row/column copy, cut, paste**; row/column context menus |
| Columns | 18 column types; column settings panel (required/default/width/freeze/hide/description); **format validation** (phone/email/url/number/length/regex); **dropdown options with background colors**; **linked selects** (map/source modes); single-click dropdown pickers; **edge drag resizing**; **frozen columns** (positional — the freeze follows reorders) |
| Filter & sort | Header filters (text/number/multi-select dropdown/color); multi-level sorts (Shift stacks); AND/OR filter combinations; one-click clear |
| Stats | Bottom stats bar (sum/average/max/min/count); **per-column

dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Installation：huluTable is a DeepSeek Harness **bundle**: an npm package carrying a patch configuration layer (`dsh.bundle.patch`). Prerequisites: the `dsh` CLI installed, and a profile that includes `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` (the web surface).

dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Option 1 — local checkout (development / trying it out)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/HuluTable
dsh web                          # open http://127.0.0.1:3080
```
section: Option 1 — local checkout (development / trying it out)

text:
dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Option 2 — install from GitHub (source + automatic build)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:huluwocom/HuluTable
```

This repository's `prepare` script builds `lib/` straight from `src/` (self-contained transpilation — no monorepo, no type-checking). pnpm ≥10 refuses to run git dependencies' build scripts until you allow it: copy the exact package key `dsh` prints into that profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-hulutable-plugin: true
```
section: Option 2 — install from GitHub (source + automatic build)

text: dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Option 2 — install from GitHub (source + automatic build)：Then re-run `add`. Consider pinning a commit (`github:you/HuluTable#<sha>`) so later pushes cannot silently change what runs.
section: Option 2 — install from GitHub (source + automatic build)

text:
dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Option 3 — tarball (prebuilt, no build permission needed)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./releases/dsh-hulutable-plugin-0.1.0.tgz
```

The `releases/` directory ships a `pnpm pack` artifact plus its SHA-256 checksum; you can also `pnpm pack` yourself.
section: Option 3 — tarball (prebuilt, no build permission needed)

text: dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Option 3 — tarball (prebuilt, no build permission needed)：> Note: the `dsh-web-app` bundle ships a built-in `ui-hulutable` row pointing at the monorepo workspace package. This bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` **disables the built-in row** and **inserts an independent row** (patches cannot rename a row, hence disable+insert), so the standalone version takes effect after installation. Once published to npm, `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hulutable-plugin` is equivalent to the three options above.
section: Option 3 — tarball (prebuilt, no build permission needed)

text:
dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Development：```sh
pnpm install            # installs deps; prepare runs the build automatically (tsdown → lib/)
pnpm run build          # builds the node half + browser half (lib/index.js, lib/invariant.js, lib/client.js)
pnpm run watch          # rebuild on change
pnpm run pack           # build and pack a tarball into releases/

dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Type-checking and tests (SDK required)：The `@deepseek-ai/*` SDK packages are not yet published to npm; at runtime the web shell provides the platform modules. Type-checking and the test suite need a local [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) checkout linked in:

dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Type-checking and tests (SDK required)：```sh
pnpm link-sdk /path/to/deepseek-harness   # writes link: devDependencies and runs pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck                        # tsc --noEmit
pnpm run test                             # vitest (jsdom)
pnpm run coverage                         # 100% coverage gate

The build itself (`prepare` / `build`) needs **no** SDK: type-only imports are erased during transpilation, and cross-plugin value imports are rejected at build time by the purity gate.

dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Architecture：```
src/
├── index.ts                 # node half (deliberately empty — all behavior is browser-side)
├── invariant.ts             # package invariant companion (loaded via the "./invariant" export)
└── client/                  # browser half (dsh.client, platform: web)

dsh-hulutable-plugin README · Performance & data：- Virtual scrolling: only the visible window (±4 row/column overscan) renders; scrolling is rAF-throttled; cells are `React.memo`.
- Undo is **delta-level** (only changed cells/structure are recorded), independent of table size; formula recomputation touches only formula cells.
- IndexedDB writes are debounced (500ms + immediate on pagehide); storage unavailability (private mode) degrades to in-memory mode.
- First load is about 1.6MB (SheetJS included, ~400KB gzip), then browser-cached.
